name: Shirokanedai
tagline: Roppongi in 13 minutes and Shibuya in 15 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 23 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 21 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 30.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 14.3 m to 30.8 m, a difference of 16.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 東京大学医科学研究所附属病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is NTT東日本関東病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line runs at 156% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 駒込→本駒込, which this station is not on. Toei Mita Line runs at 146%. Its busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000 and 2LDK ¥420,000 to ¥430,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Takanawadai, but Shirokanedai is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shirokanedai. One-room rents run about ¥24,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: Shirokane-Takanawa is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Shirokanedai is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shirokanedai. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who want plenty of places to eat out
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 目黒通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
The nearest big road, プラチナ通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
